notes: Sequential alternating fresh-process pairs, four workers on CPUs 0-3; same frozen verifying traffic client on CPUs 4-7. 64 peers/32 pairs, window 16, 15 seconds per run, every value/order verified. Frozen traffic client intentionally drops 64 TCP handles at timing end; transport/write errors must account for exactly those 64 departures. These timing runs do not verify graceful Close; separate fragment/JS/reference campaigns do. CPU includes setup/teardown. Histogram percentiles are upper bounds. No compile/load overlaps.
